palettes.note: NextGen — sky accent on deep navy chrome, amber for warnings (logo duo). Default.
Neon — logo cyan accent, teal-black chrome.
Amber — logo amber accent, warm near-black chrome.
Slate — neutral graphite chrome, muted sage accent
Ember — warm copper accent, charcoal chrome (not cream/terracotta).
Arctic — icy blue surfaces, cool azure accent.
Rose — muted coral accent on cool gray (not purple).
Meadow — fresh lime chartreuse (distinct from forest).
Copper — metallic bronze (warmer metal than ember orange).
Brick — clay red on cool gray (not cream/terracotta).
Pearl — soft luminous neutrals with silver-teal accent.
Bronze — metallic warm gold-brown (distinct from copper).
Violet — soft purple accent, plum chrome.
Indigo — deep blue-violet accent, midnight chrome.
Mono — pure neutral grayscale, no hue.
Contrast — maximum legibility: black, white, strong blue / yellow accents.
Dusk — warm orange accent on twilight plum.
